title: Shifted ordinary etale root-line comparisons
statement: Fix the finite-type spaces of [def-sf-datum], a commutative coefficient ring $A$, and $N>0$ killing $A$ and invertible on the schemes in question. From the actual root powers of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], set $T_{X,d}$ equal to the ordinary etale $d$-th Tate root line in degree zero, shifted by $2d$, for $d\ge0$. Its pullback comparison is the single-complex pullback comparison followed by root-normalized pullback and the actual shift comparison. Its product $T_{X,d}\otimes^LT_{X,e}\cong T_{X,d+e}$ uses the derived tensor shift comparison, the single-complex tensor comparison justified by rank-one flatness, root multiplication, and the canonical even-shift arithmetic identification. This includes $d=0$, empty schemes and the zero coefficient ring. These are canonical line comparisons, not a purity assertion.
